adjudication.rationale: The migration inserts `h` verbatim via raw SQL (`VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) without trimming/normalizing, and because it uses `execute` it bypasses the `EmbeddableHost` model’s `before_validation` stripping of scheme/path. The new allow-check (`EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` -> `uri.host` then `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`) will not match rows stored as `http://...` or `https://.../path`, whereas the old `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` normalized entries via `URI(h).host` / `sub(/^https?:\/\//,'')`. So existing configured hosts containing scheme/path can become non-matching after deploy, breaking embedding/TopicRetriever.
